panels.title: Activator · Attivazioni

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let validOps = 
    AppDependencies
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
    | where Name startswith "POST" and Name contains "/rtpactivator/activations"
    | distinct OperationId;

let deps =
    AppDependencies
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
    | where Name startswith "POST" and Name contains "/rtpactivator/activations"
    | extend JWT_Subject = tostring(Properties["Request-X-JWT-Subject"])
    | summarize JWT_Subject = any(JWT_Subject) by OperationId;

AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
| where Name startswith "POST" and Name contains "activations"
| join kind=inner validOps on OperationId
| join kind=leftouter deps on OperationId
| extend JWT_Subject = iif(isempty(JWT_Subject), "UNKNOWN", JWT_Subject)
| where $__contains(JWT_Subject, $activator_subject)
| summarize count_ = count() by StatusCode = ResultCode
| order by count_ desc

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message has "Error during activation process for SP"
| where Message has "Authenticated user doesn't have permission to perform this action"
| extend props = todynamic(Properties)
| extend tokenSpId = tostring(props["sub_token"])
| extend bodySpId = extract(@"Error during activation process for SP\s+([^:]+):", 1, Message)
| where isnotempty(tokenSpId) and isnotempty(bodySpId)
| where tokenSpId != bodySpId
| summarize ['Error Count'] = count()
  by ['Token SP ID'] = tokenSpId, ['Body SP ID'] = bodySpId
| order by ['Error Count'] desc

panels.description: 'OTP Generato' è il totale degli OTP emessi: comprende completati, falliti e mai usati.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let data = AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-activator'
| where Message startswith "Payer already exists, generating takeover OTP"
    or Message startswith "OTP expired due to expiration time exceeded"
    or Message startswith "Request rejected due to nonexistent OTP"
    or Message startswith "Payer taken over with new id:"
    or Message startswith "Error taking over payer:"
| extend Motivo = case(
    Message startswith "Payer already exists, generating takeover OTP", "OTP Generato",
    Message startswith "Payer taken over with new id:", "Takeover Completato",
    Message startswith "Error taking over payer:", "Takeover Fallito",
    Message startswith "OTP expired due to expiration time exceeded", "OTP Scaduto",
    Message startswith "Request rejected due to nonexistent OTP", "OTP Inesistente",
    "Altro"
)
| summarize Conteggio = count() by Motivo;
let summary = datatable(Motivo:string, Conteggio:long) [
    "OTP Generato", 0,
    "Takeover Completato", 0,
    "Takeover Fallito", 0,
    "OTP Scaduto", 0,
    "OTP Inesistente", 0
]
| union data
| summarize Conteggio = sum(Conteggio) by Motivo;
let generati = toscalar(summary | where Motivo == "OTP Generato" | project Conteggio);
let completati = toscalar(summary | where Motivo == "Takeover Completato" | project Conteggio);
let falliti = toscalar(summary | where Motivo == "Takeover Fallito" | project Conteggio);
summary
| union (print Motivo = "OTP Generati e Mai Usati", Conteggio = max_of(generati - completati - falliti, 0))

panels.title: Monitoraggio degli OTP generati

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let validOps = 
    AppDependencies
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
    | where Name has "POST /rtpactivator/activations" and Name has "takeover"
    | distinct OperationId;

let deps =
    AppDependencies
    | where Name has "takeover"
    | extend JWT_Subject = tostring(Properties["Request-X-JWT-Subject"])
    | extend activation_id_dep = extract(@"activations/([^/]+)/takeover", 1, Name)
    | summarize JWT_Subject = any(JWT_Subject), activation_id_dep = any(activation_id_dep) by OperationId;

let ex =
    AppExceptions
    | where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
    | summarize InnermostMessage = any(InnermostMessage) by OperationId;

let tr =
    AppTraces
    | where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
    | extend activation_id_trace = tostring(Properties.activation_id)
    | where isnotempty(activation_id_trace)
    | summarize activation_id_trace = any(activation_id_trace) by OperationId;

AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
| where Name startswith "POST" and Name contains "takeover"
| join kind=inner validOps on OperationId
| where ResultCode != "201" and ResultCode != "409"
| project OperationId, TimeGenerated, Name, ResultCode
| join kind=leftouter deps on OperationId
| join kind=leftouter ex on OperationId
| join kind=leftouter tr on OperationId
| extend JWT_Subject = iif(isempty(JWT_Subject), "UNKNOWN", JWT_Subject)
| extend activation_id = coalesce(activation_id_dep, activation_id_trace, "N/A")
| extend Motivo = iif(isempty(InnermostMessage), "N/A", InnermostMessage)
| where $__contains(JWT_Subject, $activator_subject)
| summarize Conteggio = count() by ["Activation ID"] = activation_id, ["Service Provider"] = JWT_Subject, ["Status Code"] = ResultCode, Motivo
| order by Conteggio desc
